rule: abs(value-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference); reject nonfinite, missing, duplicate, skipped, blocked or unexpected required records

performance.timing_policy: Correctness before timing; all repetitions retained; median and range reported; comparisons valid only within the same frozen machine/toolchain profile

statistical_policy.estimator: Bernoulli hit fraction with two-sided Wilson score interval; independent replicate streams
statistical_policy.multiplicity: Bonferroni family alpha 0.05 across all predeclared benchmark quantities; enumerate quantities before execution
statistical_policy.convergence: Compare all three sample counts; aggregate RMS error must decrease; retain every seed and investigate every interval miss; no selective rerun-to-pass
statistical_policy.scope: Policy frozen for WP-12 radiation implementation; Q0 does not execute or qualify a ray tracer
statistical_policy.simultaneous_interval_coverage: 1 - 0.05/M per interval for M predeclared family quantities
